bug: Primed native readiness cannot be consumed while the owner runs synchronous SQL/manifest initialization. The unchanged ten-second readiness deadline can expire before the already queued frame is consumed.

regressionBefore.newFailure: async owner consumes native readiness before a synchronous engine pass can exhaust its ten-second startup bound

change: Await the exact module-created readiness capability before heavy SQL initialization, then reverify physical identity under the retained writer lock. Synchronous admission and initial durable intent remain before SQL commit; startup still requires its independent exact durable ACK.
invariants: readiness is not admission or persistence authority
await actual child close before readiness failure
writer ownership retained during await and cleanup
original expiries and exact ACK versions unchanged
no plaintext-root cache or cross-transaction proof
ephemeral key handoff cleared after construction
